statement: All actual quotients to global nonopen orbits enlarge the exponential region: at least three independent lifted partitions give the same actual Lie group and the uniform1913-word extension on the entire closure. On the remaining components, finitely many operator-orbit representatives with compact actual operator quotients give a contraction across every accumulation of all their operator translates, with joint inverses and exact agreement with the enlarged exponential prescription.
depends_on: C30-C33 actual proper operator images and intrinsic contractions; C42 global evaluation and quotient maps; C43-C49 global quotient coordinate and Lie comparisons; C50 uniform word and exact winding proof; C51 compact fundamental set; C52 intrinsic hybrid replacement and diagonal boundary argument
manuscript_passages: Section23, folios140-141, scans279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison, global quotient maps and arbitrary accumulation under finitely many operator representatives
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Every global quotient and each operator transport is written explicitly; the finite-representative and compact-quotient scope is retained.
notes: The full family now contains every z in Fix(L_x) on any nonopen orbit, without requiring z in the source frontier. The C49 Polish quotient acts on each such target because its restriction kernel fixes the image by equivariance. All C50 uniform-word hypotheses transfer to the enlarged union. For remaining finitely many H-representatives, an accumulating sequence is h_n q_n y_n with y_n in one fixed compact fundamental set after a subsequence. Approximation of q_n by actual stabilizers is performed after composition with h_n on all contraction and inverse images, so no uniform modulus of h_n is assumed. The open orbit map, exact commutation and C42 evaluation force a global quotient limit covered by the intrinsic hybrid equations. Diagonal approximation proves full closure continuity and inverse continuity. Arbitrarily many H-inequivalent components, noncocompact quotients, and extension through remaining nonopen regions stay unresolved.
